messages:
alex-m: Quick check — staging overlay `terraform plan` is failing in CI after I rebased tf modules. Error mentions `aws_secretsmanager_secret_version` not found for /redwood/staging/runner. Anyone seen this when promoting secrets from SSM -> SecretsManager?

jess: hmm, seen that when a resource was renamed or state drifted. Can you paste the `terraform plan` error or the failing CI log? :thinking_face: 

alex-m: paste from CI job: 
```
Error: Resource not found: aws_secretsmanager_secret_version.runner
  on modules/secrets/main.tf line 42, in resource \"aws_secretsmanager_secret_version\" \"runner\":
 42: resource \"aws_secretsmanager_secret_version\" \"runner\" {
```
Looks like the secret resource is referenced but not present in state.

rafael: that usually means we changed the secret resource name/path in the module and didn't import the existing secret into the new resource. We moved the path var from `/redwood/${env}/` -> `/platform/${env}/` in PR #4223 last week. Did your promote include that PR?

alex-m: I'm promoting staging -> prod and my staging branch includes #4890 which touches the secrets module. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4890

sasha: yeah PR #4223 was merged earlier. For safe promo you need a small migration step: create the new secret resource (create-only), import the secret into the new resource, then switch references. Otherwise plan will try to create/delete unexpectedly.

samir: suggestion: add an overlay var `secrets_migration_mode = \"create-only\"` in the staging kustomize overlay so the infra apply job creates the new secret resource but doesn't delete the old one. That makes the gate reversible.

jess: also update the release gate — add a pipeline check `wait_for_secrets_migration` that verifies an annotation or annotation flag on the k8s secret. e.g. `kubectl -n infra get secret redwood-secrets -o jsonpath='{.metadata.annotations\\.migrated}'` :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: build 2085 for infra-apply-staging started by @alex-m — job url: https://ci.internal.redwood/builds/2085

rafael: if you need to import manually, here's the tf snippet we used: 
```bash
# import existing secrets to new resource
terraform import module.secrets.aws_secretsmanager_secret.new_secret arn:aws:secretsmanager:us-west-2:123456:secret:platform-staging-XXX
```
You can run that from the infra repo workspace for staging.

alex-m: ok will try migration-mode + import if plan still fails. Pinging @sasha to add the gating check for the canary run.

sasha: will add a gating step in pipeline.yml and a tiny helper script `scripts/check_secrets_migrated.sh`. I'll set a 1h timeout on the gate and put a clear rollback doc in the PR.

samir: LGTM on migration-mode approach. Also leave a note in the promo playbook about the import step and the state rename.

ajex-m: (typo) meant alex-m: thanks all, i'll push follow-up with `secrets_migration_mode = \"create-only\"` and kick CI. will report back once build 2085 finishes. :thumbsup:
